```{r}
# Score SCSY
data$SCSY_2_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_2
data$SCSY_3_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_3
data$SCSY_5_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_5
data$SCSY_7_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_7
data$SCSY_10_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_10
data$SCSY_12_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_12
data$SCSY_14_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_14
data$SCSY_16_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_16

# Calculate SCSY sub-scales
data$self_kindness <- (data$SCSY_1 + data$SCSY_9 + data$SCSY_15) / 3
data$self_judgment <- (data$SCSY_3_rev + data$SCSY_7_rev + data$SCSY_12_rev) / 3
data$common_humanity <- (data$SCSY_4 + data$SCSY_8 + data$SCSY_13) / 3
data$isolation <- (data$SCSY_2_rev + data$SCSY_10_rev + data$SCSY_16_rev) / 3
data$mindfulness <- (data$SCSY_6 + data$SCSY_11 + data$SCSY_17) / 3
data$over_identification <- (data$SCSY_5_rev + data$SCSY_5_rev) / 2

# Calculate SCSY total score (average)
data$total_score_SCSY <- (data$self_kindness + data$self_judgment + 
                    data$common_humanity + data$isolation + 
                    data$mindfulness + data$over_identification) / 6
# Standardize score for SCSY and Daydreaming
data$SCSY_norm <- scale(data$total_score_SCSY)
data$SCSY_self_kindness_norm <- scale(data$self_kindness)
data$SCSY_self_judgment_norm <- scale(data$self_judgment)
data$SCSY_common_humanity_norm <- scale(data$common_humanity)
data$SCSY_isolation_norm <- scale(data$isolation)
data$SCSY_mindfulness_norm <- scale(data$mindfulness)
data$SCSY_over_identification_norm <- scale(data$over_identification)
data$negative_dd_norm <- scale(data$dysphoric_dd)
data$positive_dd_norm <- scale(data$Positive_dd)
data$poor_attention_norm <- scale(data$attention_control)
```

```{r}
# Score CS - 16-items compassion scale
## Reverse code the Indifference items
data$CS3_R <- 6 - data$CS3
data$CS7_R <- 6 - data$CS7
data$CS11_R <- 6 - data$CS11
data$CS15_R <- 6 - data$CS15

## Calculate subscale scores (means)
data$CS_kindness <- rowMeans(data[, c("CS2", "CS6", "CS10", "CS14")])
data$CS_common_humanity <- rowMeans(data[, c("CS4", "CS8", "CS12", "CS16")])
data$CS_mindfulness <- rowMeans(data[, c("CS1", "CS5", "CS9", "CS13")])
data$CS_indifference <- rowMeans(data[, c("CS3_R", "CS7_R", "CS11_R", "CS15_R")])

## Calculate total compassion score (grand mean of all items)
data$CS_total <- rowMeans(data[, c("CS2", "CS6", "CS10", "CS14",  # Kindness
                                      "CS4", "CS8", "CS12", "CS16",    # Common Humanity
                                      "CS1", "CS5", "CS9", "CS13",     # Mindfulness
                                      "CS3_R", "CS7_R", "CS11_R", "CS15_R")])  # Reversed Indifference

## Standardize score for CS
data$CS_kindness_norm <- scale(data$CS_kindness)
data$CS_common_humanity_norm <- scale(data$CS_common_humanity)
data$CS_mindfulness_norm <- scale(data$CS_mindfulness)
data$CS_indifference_norm <- scale(data$CS_indifference)
```

```{r}
# Create a function to identify potential mediators
find_mediators <- function(dataframe, iv_cols, dv_col, threshold = 0.2) {
  # Calculate correlations
  cors <- hetcor(dataframe, std.err = FALSE)$correlations
  
  # Get correlations with IV and DV
  iv_cors <- cors[, iv_cols, drop = FALSE]
  dv_cors <- cors[, dv_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Find variables that correlate with both
  potential_mediators <- which(
    apply(abs(iv_cors) >= threshold, 1, any) &
    abs(dv_cors) >= threshold
  )
  
  return(cors[potential_mediators, c(iv_cols, dv_col), drop = FALSE])
}

# Use the function
# Replace these with your actual column names
iv_cols <- c("negative_dd_norm", "positive_dd_norm", "poor_attention_norm")
dv_col <- "obj_under"

potential_mediators <- find_mediators(dataframe, iv_cols, dv_col)

potential_mediators
```

```{r}

# Specify the mediation model
model_mediation <- '
    # Direct paths to mediator (subjective underachievement)
    SCSY_self_judgment_norm ~ a1*positive_dd_norm + a2*negative_dd_norm + a3*poor_attention_norm

    # Direct paths to outcome (objective underachievement)
    obj_under ~ b*SCSY_self_judgment_norm + c1*positive_dd_norm + c2*negative_dd_norm + c3*poor_attention_norm

    # Define indirect effects
    pos_indirect := a1*b
    dys_indirect := a2*b
    att_indirect := a3*b

    # Define total effects
    pos_total := c1 + (a1*b)
    dys_total := c2 + (a2*b)
    att_total := c3 + (a3*b)
'

# Fit the model with appropriate estimator for categorical variables
fit_mediation <- sem(model_mediation, 
                    data = data,
                    ordered = c("obj_under"),
                    estimator = "DWLS")

# Request standardized solution and indirect effects
summary(fit_mediation, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
model <- '
    daydreaming =~ positive_dd_norm + negative_dd_norm + poor_attention_norm
    
    sub_under ~ daydreaming
    obj_under ~ daydreaming + sub_under
    
    positive_dd_norm ~~ negative_dd_norm
    positive_dd_norm ~~ poor_attention_norm
    negative_dd_norm ~~ poor_attention_norm'

fit1 <- sem(model, data = data,
            ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
            estimator = "WLSMV",
            parameterization = "theta")
```


```{r}
summary(fit1, standardized = TRUE)

fitMeasures(fit1,c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "gif", "cfi", "rmr", "srmr", "rmsea"))
    
semPaths(fit1,
         what = "std",
         layout = "tree",
         fade = F,
         residuals = F)
```
